element.definition: Spiritual Mind at the highest degree is the 1st CAUSE of all causes, the Divine Mind commonly known as God who birthed all ideas, whom is within all and whom all is within. On the other hand men can be spiritual minded; indeed in our true identity we are a spirit mind. However we usually are blind to our true selves because of our lower appetites and passions. To be spiritual minded means to be connected to the spirit world, to have insight into the spirit realm, to know the Divine and the ultimate purpose of a thing, matter, or person, the absorbing of spiritual information, being in tune with the spirit of a thing, or when the Holy Spirit is the driver of one's actions and decisions.
